note: Context only. These are overlapping populations with different definitions. They are not counts of Drupal users or people excluded by the assessed release.

statistics.title: Disability
statistics.population_definition: People with significant disability, as defined by the source
limitations: Not equivalent to users excluded by any product

statistics.title: Blindness and vision impairment
statistics.measure: People with near or distance vision impairment
statistics.population_definition: People with near or distance vision impairment; not equivalent to blindness or screen-reader use
limitations: Includes a wide range of vision impairment
At least 1 billion cases are preventable or unaddressed
Not equivalent to the number of screen-reader users

statistics.title: Deafness and hearing loss
statistics.measure: People requiring rehabilitation for disabling hearing loss
statistics.population_definition: People requiring rehabilitation for disabling hearing loss
limitations: Disabling hearing loss requiring rehabilitation, not all hearing loss
Not equivalent to the number of caption users
